plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell METU and MUU due to downtrends and being below stops.
Trim QQQI to 20% to cure the concentration breach and reduce risk.
Reduce CRWD and SNOW to 5% and 2% respectively to lower single-name exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
Maintain a significant cash buffer for stability.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to small allocations to reduce risk.
Reduce METU and MUU due to downtrends and being below stops.
Trim QQQI to 20% to cure the concentration breach and balance the portfolio.
Buy TSLA at 4% as a strong scanner setup to add quality growth.
Reduce CRWD to 8% to manage single-name concentration.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month by blending broad index, quality tech, and limited leverage. It aims for risk-first growth, reducing concentration while adding a strong new setup. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth.

plan: Add to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to increase exposure.
Increase PLTU and MSFU, both uptrending leveraged ETFs, to 6% each.
Buy TSLA at 6% as a high-scoring scanner setup to lean into growth.
This plan aggressively uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups.
Maintain strict stops to manage the increased risk.
This strategy aims for stretch growth with a smaller cash buffer.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by stretching growth through leveraged ETFs and concentrated high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lose a lot fast; strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for income focus.
Sell high-beta single names (METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to near zero.
Add QQQI to 30% to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce high-beta exposure.
This plan rotates into income/covered-call ETFs for yield.
Prioritize low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by prioritizing steady monthly distributions. It cuts leverage and high-beta single names to near zero, focusing on income and broad index ETFs. Distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is cash-like income, not a savings account.
